pages.text: Although it may seem like the Risus has only appeared in the last few years or decades, the truth is far from that. It's undeniable that the world itself is facing changes. Discoveries were made of ruins, flora and fauna that had never been seen before, as well as new monsters and dangers appearing out of almost nowhere. Where the Risus differs is that there are clues - forgotten to time - of

its existence even in the past. When it comes to the earth below us, redstone might just be a mineral form of it, which would explain its ability to interact with both inorganic and organic materials, as well as hold near infinite power. However, this does require more research. A concrete clue is the written language shared between the Risus and enchantments. Enchanting is a very old practice and through time, the intricacies of how it works have been completely lost. In the present, all that

is known is that memories can be turned into magic that empowers weapons and tools; that's it. Yet for some reason, the character of this enchanting language also appear in engravings related to Risus, or whenever it is imbued into items through an Alteration Catalyst. Since the use cases of the language are similar (imbuement of an essence into an object) it points to the idea of both enchanting and the Risus originating from the same era in the past. Of course, this
brings up even more questions, like what had happened in that time between the present and that era, as well as what enchanting is and it's true purpose.
